data.cultural_impact: The name Tarannum is of Arabic origin, and it is a beautiful and common name amongst the Muslim communities, especially in South Asia. The impact of the name "Tarannum" is the happiness, joy, and delight it brings to those who bear it. It is a name that is full of positivity, representing the person as someone who spreads happiness and brings pleasure to others, creating an atmosphere of joy and merriment. The name also highlights the importance of aesthetics and beauty in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Tarannum signifies a person who seeks to bring happiness and pleasure to Allah (SWT) through their actions and deeds. The name is derived from the Arabic word "Tarannim", which means "delight", "pleasure", and "enjoyment". Thus, the spiritual significance of the name Tarannum is being a servant of Allah who seeks to please Him by striving for purity, compassion, and doing good deeds. The name is a constant reminder for the bearer to spread joy and happiness in the world as an act of worship, and to seek the pleasure of Allah in all that they do.
